concept.concept: Dark background with a single glowing moon and bold text 'I Heal People While You Sleep'
concept.audience: Night shift nurses and hospital staff
concept.rationale: Healthcare worker identity is deeply personal and gift-driven. Night shift nurses are underserved in POD. Strong emotional hook with no IP concerns.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "I Heal People While You Sleep" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a single large glowing moon centered on a solid charcoal background. Moon is a perfect circle in pale cream with a thin bright yellow glow ring around it. No stars, no clouds, no additional elements. Solid color blocks only, no gradients, no shading. Clean sharp edges, screen-print aesthetic. Composition centered with generous margins on all sides.
design.text_on_design: I Heal People While You Sleep
design.style: Bold sans-serif typeface, all caps, arched above the moon illustration in bright cream color. High contrast against charcoal background. Single-line treatment, no outline or shadow effects. Professional, modern, readable at distance.

verdict.reason: The phrase 'I Heal People While You Sleep' is a generic descriptive slogan commonly used in nurse/healthcare humor merchandise. It does not reference any known registered trademark, brand, celebrity, sports team, character, or protected slogan. The moon and dark background design elements are generic. No IP concerns identified.

image_verdict.reason: The text reads exactly 'I HEAL PEOPLE WHILE YOU SLEEP' — correctly spelled and complete. The design is a clean typographic composition on a cream circle with yellow border against a dark background. No IP concerns, no quality issues, no anatomy, no artifacts.

listing.title: Night Shift Nurse Mug 'I Heal People While You Sleep'
listing.description: A powerful mug for night shift heroes. Dark background with a single glowing moon and bold text that speaks to the dedication of nurses working overnight. Perfect for late-night coffee breaks, quiet reflection between shifts, or proud display on the break room shelf. Hospital staff, ER nurses, ICU workers, and night shift medical professionals will feel seen and appreciated. The striking design is eye-catching even in dim lighting. Ceramic construction with durable print. An honest tribute to those who heal while others sleep.
